summary.text: Natalie Murdock is a Democratic state senator from North Carolina who represents District 20, covering parts of Chatham and Durham counties, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is the only candidate listed for the seat on the general election ballot.

paragraphs.text: Murdock took office in the North Carolina Senate on April 1, 2020, succeeding Henry Michaux Jr., according to Ballotpedia.
She previously served as a Durham Soil and Water Conservation District Supervisor.

The General Assembly's website shows her committee assignments in Agriculture, Energy, and Environment; Appropriations on Department of Transportation; Appropriations/Base Budget; Finance; Health Care; and Transportation.
